## Implementation Plan (Autonomous)

**Architecture:** Full-stack feature — backend model + script execution + CodeMirror 6 frontend editor.

### Sub-Tasks

| # | Description | Complexity | Deps |
|---|-------------|------------|------|
| 1 | Add script_type fields to backend model (Job, NewJob, JobUpdate) + OpenAPI + tests | Standard | - |
| 2 | Implement script-file hook execution (temp file, interpreter dispatch, cleanup) | Standard | 1 |
| 3 | Add TypeScript types + form state for hook mode/script_type | Light | - |
| 4 | Install CodeMirror 6 npm packages | Light | - |
| 5 | Build CodeMirror editor wrapper component (ScriptEditor.tsx) | Complex | 4 |
| 6 | Rebuild PrePostHookFields with mode toggle + CodeMirror editor | Standard | 3, 5 |

### Waves
```
Wave 1 (parallel): ST1, ST3, ST4
Wave 2 (parallel): ST2, ST5
Wave 3: ST6
```

Plan reviewed and auto-approved (autonomous mode).
